scope.purpose: Evaluate the highest-fidelity historical market data available for each fixture before accepting weaker replay.

observed_facts: The Binance public data README states that Binance Data Collection offers public market data as daily or monthly files.
The checked README lists spot AggTrades, Klines, and Trades; the Trades files come from /api/v3/historicalTrades.
No spot order book, depth, or L2 archive family was found in the checked README.
The checked Tardis Binance docs include an incremental_book_L2 BTCUSDT sample dated 2019-12-01.
The checked docs list the depth channel as incremental order book updates and depthSnapshot as generated initial order book snapshots.
The checked docs state sequence-number validation for Binance order book incremental updates.
availableChannels are trade, depth, depthSnapshot, bookTicker, aggTrade, ticker, borrowInterest, recentTrades, and tokenNav.
The metadata response listed 3297 spot symbols.
BTCUSDT has trades, incremental_book_L2, quotes, book_snapshot_5, book_snapshot_25, and book_ticker data from 2019-03-30 to 2026-06-07.
The PMXT archive describes free hourly snapshots of Polymarket, Kalshi, Limitless, and Opinion orderbook data in Parquet format.
The archive page states the data is updated every hour.
The archive page footer states CC BY 4.0 licensing and commercial use allowed with attribution.
The checked Kalshi index page listed hourly kalshi_orderbook_YYYY-MM-DDTHH.parquet objects.
The parsed sample had 100 visible objects, average 54.8 MB per hour, minimum 14.6 MB, and maximum 126.8 MB.
The visible sample extrapolates to about 1.28 GB per day and 0.46 TB per year before conversion, catalog writes, validation scans, and downstream analytics.
The checked Tardis Hyperliquid docs include incremental_book_L2 and trades samples for BTC dated 2024-12-01.
The checked docs list l2Book as an order book snapshot stream.
The checked docs list bbo as available since 2025-06-26.
availableChannels are trades, l2Book, bbo, activeAssetCtx, and activeSpotAssetCtx.
The metadata response listed 694 available symbols: 393 perpetual and 301 spot.
The dataset symbols summary listed 393 perpetual symbols and 301 spot symbols with incremental_book_L2.
The dataset symbols summary listed 300 spot symbols whose ids begin with @ and have incremental_book_L2.
This metadata does not by itself bind HIP-4 outcomeMeta outcome ids or #encoded current outcome books to historical dataset symbols.
The checked Hyperliquid docs state the requester pays transfer costs.
The checked docs state historical data is uploaded approximately once a month, with no timely-update guarantee and possible missing data.
The checked docs state L2 book snapshots are available in market_data and asset contexts are available in asset_ctxs; no other historical data sets are provided via S3.
The current outcomeMeta sample has top-level outcomes and questions keys.
Outcome rows expose description, name, outcome, quoteToken, and sideSpecs.
The sample remains bounded/current-only until historical archive coverage and parser fidelity are proven.
The checked NT BinaryOption instrument mapping requires activation_ns, expiration_ns, precision fields, and increment fields not present in outcomeMeta.
The current market data probe used outcome 101 side 0 encoded as #1010 and reached current l2Book/candle data.
The mapping conclusion blocks instrument and replay mapping until source-backed checked fields and accepted historical replay coverage exist.

official_or_free_candidates.reason: The official public archive evidence proves trades/aggTrades/klines, not historical L2 order book data.

paid_or_vendor_candidates.reason: Tardis proves Binance depth/incremental_book_L2 availability for BTCUSDT, but source selection still requires accepted license, cost, exact symbol/window coverage, sample-to-NT catalog mapping, and storage proof.

fixture_evaluations.selection_guard: Do not select the official lower-fidelity Binance trade archive for execution-quality claims while the Tardis L2 candidate remains unaccepted; trade replay may only support explicit lower-fidelity claims.

official_or_free_candidates.reason: PMXT Polymarket is retained only as bounded selected-source/bootstrap evidence. It must not be promoted into durable broad source selection; reusable Polymarket instrument and parser behavior must come from pinned NT nautilus-polymarket surfaces.

paid_or_vendor_candidates.provider: Telonex or comparable paid Polymarket source
paid_or_vendor_candidates.reason: Paid Polymarket alternatives are separate durable-history candidates only if a broad historical L2 replay requirement is explicitly accepted; they are not unlocked by one-off PMXT bootstrap evidence.

fixture_evaluations.selection_guard: Do not select PMXT Polymarket as a durable broad backfill source. Use it only for explicitly configured one-off selected-source proof data; durable Polymarket catalog/backtest paths must reuse pinned NT Polymarket provider/parser surfaces and pass separate source-proof acceptance.

official_or_free_candidates.reason: Existing Kalshi endpoint proof found historical markets/trades/candlesticks but did not prove historical orderbook snapshots or deltas.
The PMXT Kalshi archive is evidence for bounded one-off backfill/projection experiments only. It is not selected as a reusable durable Kalshi L2 source without a separate source-proofed plan.

fixture_evaluations.selection_guard: Do not treat PMXT Kalshi as a standing blocker or durable source candidate. Official Kalshi lower-fidelity paths may proceed only through explicit claim limits; any one-off PMXT Kalshi use needs its own bounded proof artifact.

official_or_free_candidates.reason: Current outcomeMeta and current encoded book/candle probes do not prove historical HIP-4 outcome L2/trade replay coverage or checked NT BinaryOption instrument fields.

Official docs prove market_data L2 book snapshots exist for covered assets, but requester-pays, monthly lag, possible missing data, exact HIP-4 outcome symbol coverage, and #encoded outcome sample paths remain unproven.

paid_or_vendor_candidates.reason: Tardis proves generic Hyperliquid l2Book and dataset L2 availability for perpetual and spot symbols, but does not yet prove that HIP-4 outcomeMeta outcome ids or #encoded current outcome books map to historical Tardis dataset symbols.

fixture_evaluations.selection_guard: Keep HIP-4 historical execution-quality replay as unproven and use FORWARD_CAPTURE_PENDING unless exact outcome history, checked instrument fields, NT mapping, license, cost, and storage proof pass.

slow_backfill_controls: Run source-proof and coverage-ledger checks before object download or conversion.
Reject any candidate with unresolved source, license, schema, coverage, NT mapping, storage, or cost gates before broad backfill.
Use archive index/object metadata to estimate bytes before downloading payloads.
Start with representative samples and schema inspection, not whole-history pulls.
Cap every proof run by fixture, source binding, data family, time window, object count, and byte budget.
Record idempotent manifests, source object hashes, object byte counts, and gap reasons before publishing canonical data.
Do not choose a source by venue name; choose by accepted source-proof state, fidelity, claim limits, NT mapping, and cost proof.
Do not use lower-fidelity data for execution-quality claims; lower-fidelity outputs must carry explicit claim limits.

task_conclusion.reason: The highest-fidelity currently evidenced historical candidates are identified per fixture, weaker replay is explicitly blocked from execution-quality use, and source selection/backfill remain gated by BTE-022 and BTE-027.
